# Published z-Tree treatments

z-Tree treatments published with experiments, played by `test/ztree-published.test.js` to their end
by jtree's generic z-Tree bot (`source/dialects/ztree/bots.js`).

They were published without a licence, so they are not in this repository: the test downloads them
here the first time it runs (the files are ignored by git), and skips when it cannot.

- `duffy-puzzello/`: the treatments of the replication of Duffy and Puzzello (2014), "Gift Exchange
  versus Monetary Exchange: Theory and Evidence" (*American Economic Review* 104(6)), in the
  Experimental Economics Replication Project (Camerer et al. 2016, *Science* 351(6280)):
  https://osf.io/x2wcy/ (project https://osf.io/bzm54/). The money treatment (`M6_G1` to `M6_G8`,
  one per session), the no-money treatment (`NM6_G1` to `NM6_G8`), a Holt–Laury risk task (`HL`)
  and the payment questionnaire (`PaymentInfo.ztq`).
